episodes.title: Burn Them All to the F*cking Ground
episodes.summary: The cameras are back and rolling with everyone's favorite family. They are navigating through their new normal; motherhood, relationships, and career goals. As the family celebrates new ventures, a video from the past resurfaces.

episodes.title: Did Somebody Tape That?
episodes.summary: As Kim rehearses for her Saturday Night Live hosting debut, her past continues to haunt her. Khloé deals with her ongoing anxiety and the scrutiny of being in the public eye. Meanwhile, things with Kourtney and Travis Barker are getting more serious.

episodes.title: Live From New York
episodes.summary: In NYC, As Kim prepares for her SNL debut, an unexpected gesture offers her some much-needed closure. Back in LA, Kris and Khloé learn some details that could put Travis' surprise proposal to Kourtney at risk.

episodes.title: We're Celebrating Sex
episodes.summary: Travis Barker and the whole Kardashian family surprise Kourtney with a marriage proposal in Santa Barbara. With love in the air, Khloe and Kim discuss the next phases of their relationships.

episodes.title: Who is Kim K?
episodes.summary: While the whole family celebrates different milestones, one person is feeling left out. Scott must come to terms with his new role in the family dynamic. Kim anxiously prepares for her final attempt at the bar exam.

episodes.title: This is a Life or Death Situation
episodes.summary: Kim awaits her bar exam results as she fights to save the life of a man on death row. Kourtney and Travis continue blending their families while Kendall is caught in the middle with Scott.

episodes.title: Where I've Been and Where I Wanna Go
episodes.summary: Kim's newfound independence takes her to amazing heights in the world of fashion. Kris faces a challenge as a mom and manager while Kourtney and Travis explore new avenues on their fertility journey.

episodes.title: Never Go Against the Family
episodes.summary: Khloé coaches Kris through her MasterClass taping while Kim finally opens up about her love life. Kourtney Pooshes her business to the next level with a Goop collab.

episodes.title: Bucket List Goals
episodes.summary: Kim lands in paradise to shoot a highly anticipated cover, while Khloé and Kourtney focus on their brands. Shocking news about Tristan is revealed.

episodes.title: Enough is Enough
episodes.summary: As the season wraps up, Kris embarks on yet another new business venture. Khloé faces gut-wrenching news that throws her plans for a bright future into turmoil.

episodes.title: I Have Something to Tell You...
episodes.summary: As the Kardashians return for season two, Khloé reveals shocking news that will change the family forever.

episodes.title: Prada You!
episodes.summary: Kylie welcomes baby number two while Kourtney plans her dream wedding. Khloé sees how her past trauma has affected her brain. Kim and Kendall head to Milan to attend and walk in the Prada show.

episodes.title: Life Can Change On A Dime
episodes.summary: In Palm Springs, Kris experiments with an herbal treatment to help her hip pain as Khloé hopes the desert's healing properties help mend her wounds. Kim and Kendall take over Milan for the Prada runway show.

episodes.title: We're Built For This
episodes.summary: While Kris awaits surgery, she enlists Martha Stewart to cheer up Khloé. Kim faces backlash from a Variety interview and Kendall dabbles in real estate.

episodes.title: One Night In Miami
episodes.summary: Kris undergoes hip surgery and begins her road to recovery while Khloé and Kim embark on a much-needed girls trip to Miami. Kendall invites Kylie to an event in Las Vegas and faces her fears of being in the public eye.

episodes.title: You Have No Idea How Iconic This Is!
episodes.summary: Khloé must relive past drama at a big event where her anxiety resurfaces on the red carpet. Kim meets some of her idols and is inspired to find the perfect balance between work, family, and her personal life.

episodes.title: What's more American than Marilyn Monroe?
episodes.summary: For the upcoming Met gala, Kim aims to wear Marilyn Monroe's dress but obstacles stand in her way. Kourtney plans her Italian wedding while her family prepares for a trial.

episodes.title: I Never Thought I'd See The Day
episodes.summary: In Milan, Kourtney sees her wedding dress for the first time while Kim makes one last attempt to wear the Marilyn Monroe dress. The family preps for the Met Ball as the trial comes to a close.

episodes.title: It's Met Monday!
episodes.summary: For the first time, the entire family attends the Met Ball, but the pending trial verdict threatens to put a damper on the momentous event.

episodes.title: Here's to Paris
episodes.summary: In the season finale, Kim strikes a balance between family and work at Paris Fashion Week. Kylie takes a trip of her own while the family meets Khloé's new baby.

episodes.title: Can Everyone Get Their Sh*t Together?
episodes.summary: The Kardashians are back for season three! A newly single Kim attempts to have a more drama-free life but an ex continues to make things more complicated. Kendall and Kylie enjoy some sisterly bonding. Meanwhile, Khloé has a potential health scare.

episodes.title: Don't Want It, Don't Need It, I'm Done.
episodes.summary: Amidst personal drama, Kim pursues a career-changing fashion endeavor. While recovering from her health scare, Khloé has a heart-to-heart with a close friend. Meanwhile, Kylie travels to Europe to check in on her beauty empire.

episodes.title: Everything is My Fault!
episodes.summary: The countdown to Milan Fashion Week begins, but an unforeseen circumstance puts Kim's D&G collaboration in jeopardy. The launch of Kourtney's new business pushes her to confront her anxieties, and Khloé reveals the nature of her relationship with Tristan.

episodes.title: Ciao, Kim
episodes.summary: Kim is in the final stages of prep for her creative directorial debut with Dolce & Gabbana, but her focus is pulled back as tensions with Kourtney arise. Kylie and Kendall swap the glitz and glam of fashion week to saddle up.

episodes.title: You Think I Need Your Permission?
episodes.summary: In Milan, Kim attempts to reach new career goals in the world of fashion, and Khloé is met with an unexpected romantic surprise. Back in California, Kourtney and Travis celebrate their love in a very familiar setting.

episodes.title: The Tension is Brewing
episodes.summary: Khloé plans a surprise birthday party for Kim, but outside forces get in the way. Kris worries that the life she built for her family can be a curse, while Kourtney contemplates when to confront Kim.

episodes.title: Deeper Than Dolce
episodes.summary: Kourtney and Kim attempt to clear the air as Kris prepares for her birthday bash. Kim's patience and stability are put to the test after her ex-husband is in the news.

episodes.title: I Have Some Very Important News
episodes.summary: Kourtney gathers the family to record a holiday album in hopes of bringing them closer. Khloé taps into her maternal instincts to assist her young niece, while a big announcement from Kim catches the family off guard.

episodes.title: Feel, Deal, Heal
episodes.summary: Kim sorts through heaps of memories from her past, while Kylie and Kourtney open up about beauty standards. Khloé is nominated for a big award.

episodes.title: What Just Happened?
episodes.summary: As the season comes to an end, the family celebrates the holidays together. Meanwhile, shocking news changes things forever.

episodes.title: You're A Witch And I Hate You
episodes.summary: The Kardashians are back for season 4! The family heads to Cabo San Lucas, but Kourtney and Kim get into a heated argument that changes the dynamic of the trip.

episodes.title: When Is Being Me Gonna Be Okay?
episodes.summary: Kim shares her business acumen on a cross-country trip and ponders second chances. Kris takes some time to refocus on her relationship and herself, while Khloé navigates her new normal with Tristan.

episodes.title: A Step in the Right Direction
episodes.summary: Kim heads back to Milan as her relationship with Kourtney gets to a better place. Khloé helps Scott remedy his back pain and a midlife crisis, meanwhile Kris assists Tristan in landing a dream job.

episodes.title: London Here We Come
episodes.summary: Kim heads to London for a soccer moms' trip with her son and friends. Kris wants everyone to find love, so she and Khloé set up Scott on a blind date. Later, Kris worries how Khloé will react if Tristan moves on.

episodes.title: It Takes A Village
episodes.summary: Khloé navigates her increasingly complicated living situation while throwing a birthday party for True. Kim continues her European soccer trip and meets a potential date for the Met Gala. Meanwhile, the family helps Scott with his back problems.

episodes.title: You're Spiraling
episodes.summary: The family celebrates Easter weekend in Palm Springs. Later, Malika accompanies Kim on an important trip, while Khloé's frustration with her management team leads to a heated conversation with Kris.

episodes.title: A Short-Term Fight
episodes.summary: Kim heads to Vegas to officiate a wedding but forgets to invite someone. Meanwhile, Kris tries to mend things with Khloé with a futuristic surprise. Later, Kim tries to get Khloé out of the house for a night on the town.

episodes.title: Not Forgotten, Not Forgiven
episodes.summary: Tristan has one on one chats with Khloé's sisters to finally confront his transgressions. Kim over-exerts herself and turns to Kris for advice. Meanwhile Kourtney goes on tour with her husband.

episodes.title: You Have Ruined Our Family
episodes.summary: Kim, Kendall & Kylie attend the Met Gala while North gives critiques. Kris meets with Oscar winner Brian Grazer about a documentary, as Khloé interviews her cousin Cici about their family history. Kourtney has a big surprise to share.

episodes.title: Buckle Up and Let's Go
episodes.summary: In the season finale, Kourtney takes Kris and Khloé on tour to San Diego. Kim struggles with the pressures of acting in a TV show, and the family gathers to celebrate Kourtney and Travis at their gender reveal.

episodes.title: Welcome to my Mind
episodes.summary: Kourtney navigates her pregnancy while Kris plans the perfect baby shower. Khloé is presented with a fresh start while facing pressure from Kim to change her ways. Kendall and Kylie make time for an overdue sisterly catch up in Paris.

episodes.title: Get it Together
episodes.summary: Kris joins Kendall in Paris, to support her as she steps into a new role. Kourtney is at home preparing for baby Barker's arrival. Meanwhile, Kim has an exciting new offer, but can she add another thing to her plate?

episodes.title: This is Going to be Really Hot Tea
episodes.summary: It's Kim's birthday week but before she can celebrate, she is summoned to Jury Duty. Kris and Kendall hang out with new bestie, The Golden Bachelor, who comforts Kris as she worries about a new ailment. Khloé gets real about her romantic life and Tristan.

episodes.title: I'm the Man of the Year!
episodes.summary: Kris helps Kourtney to prepare for the arrival of her son, while Malika looks to Khloé as she navigates the idea of having another child. Kim leans into being labeled ‘cringey' by her kids while being honored by a magazine as Man of the Year.

episodes.title: Baby Rocky
episodes.summary: In her acting era, Kim pursues yet another project while Khloé finally leaves her bubble. Kylie opens up to Kendall about how online comments affect her. Kourtney and Travis share personal footage of the birth of their son.

episodes.title: Stick Up Your Ass
episodes.summary: As a new mom, Kourtney passes the Christmas Eve party torch to Kim, who goes big. The family heads to Aspen on vacation where the vibe turns frosty after mom shaming each other.

episodes.title: The Peak and The Pit
episodes.summary: In Aspen, Khloé is annoyed when Kim keeps telling her to be present during their ski trip. Meanwhile Kourtney temporarily steps out of her baby bubble to support Travis, and Kris gets emotional sharing news about her health.

episodes.title: This Is My Most Important Job
episodes.summary: Kim and Kourtney face new chapters of motherhood, while Kris struggles to process her upcoming surgery. The whole family gets together for a photoshoot before Kim heads to New Orleans to meet with Gypsy Rose Blanchard.

episodes.title: Second Chances
episodes.summary: Kris recovers from her surgery, while Kourtney and her kids go on tour with Travis in Australia. Kim takes Khloé to a prison to see how rehabilitation and therapy can work.

episodes.title: I Can't Do This
episodes.summary: Kim, Khloé, Kris, and Scott take a test to find out what their biological age actually is, while Kourtney wraps up her Australia trip. The family gathers at Kylie's house to reflect on their incredible year.

episodes.title: Literally Falling Apart
episodes.summary: The family is back! Before Khloé turns 40, she is on mission to shed her painful past. Kim stresses over a trip to the White House to discuss prison reform, and Kourtney celebrates her 45th birthday at a familiar restaurant.

episodes.title: I Don't Erase What Happened
episodes.summary: Kim faces the MET gala after dealing with backlash from the night before, while Khloé is leaving the burdens of her past behind her. Kourtney organizes a surprise family dinner that isn't an easy ride.

episodes.title: I Just Can't Wait to be King
episodes.summary: Kim follows in Kris' footsteps and takes on the Momager role when North is presented with an opportunity. Kendall and Kylie bring their new collaboration to Sin City, while Khloé tries to help Scott find a new assistant.

episodes.title: She Said Yes!
episodes.summary: Kim is terrified of opening old wounds with Kourtney when a new business opportunity arises. Kris, Khloé, and Kim have dinner with a renowned longevity specialist, before ending the week at a concert for an epic night!

episodes.title: Khloéwood
episodes.summary: Khloé is ready to celebrate as she nears her 40th birthday! While she takes a road trip to Santa Barbara, Kim goes all out planning a show-stopping bash for Khloé, but her sisters don't see eye to eye on the vision for the party.

episodes.title: Kim and Khloé Take India
episodes.summary: Kim and Khloé head to India for an extravagant wedding. Back in LA, Kourtney supports Travis in a 5k race, meanwhile Kris deals with the loss of someone close to her.

episodes.title: Payback’s a Bitch
episodes.summary: Kim and Khloé end their travels with a stop in Italy, and Kris throws MJ's 90th birthday party, all while stressing over a bear roaming the neighborhood. Kendall and Kylie open up about Khloé and Lamar's meeting.

episodes.title: She Is So Elle Woods
episodes.summary: Khloé wakes up sick on the morning of her first podcast while Kim shares her passion with Kendall and Scott at a prison fire camp. Kris gathers all her grandkids together for a trip to the farm.

episodes.title: We’re Going Camping!
episodes.summary: The family gets together to celebrate a milestone birthday, but it takes an unexpected turn. Kris, Kim, and Khloé head out to Joshua Tree for a "glamping" trip, while Kendall goes on a college tour to promote her brand.

episodes.title: Get the Hell Out of Dodge
episodes.summary: On the season six finale, Khloé heads to London with Kris to launch her new fragrance. Before she leaves, Kendall and Kylie sit down with her to talk about Lamar. Back in LA, the family gathers to celebrate Kim's birthday.

episodes.title: Feels Like the Old Days
episodes.summary: The family returns for Season 7! Kris is selling their iconic family home and wants to host one final dinner party. Kourtney voices strong opinions about her sisters' choices, meanwhile Kim is working on a new project, but her past continues to haunt her.

episodes.title: She Was Such a Hater
episodes.summary: Caitlyn is back to say goodbye to the family house, after Kris extends an olive branch. Kris meets Glenn Close on the set of Kim's new tv show and has an invitation for her. Kourtney works with Julia Fox, meanwhile a fishy feud is cooking with Khloé.

episodes.title: I’m About to Lose My Shit
episodes.summary: Tension grows between Kourtney and Khloé over drama in the group chat. Kim bonds with the cast of her series All's Fair while balancing work and motherhood, meanwhile Kris aims for zen, but chaos puts her patience to the test.

episodes.title: A Tragedy in Reality TV
episodes.summary: Khloé and Kris shop for a family home in the afterlife, while Kourtney protests to protect their current homes. Kim wraps on set of her first leading role, but it's cut short when scary new information comes to light, threatening everything she's built.

episodes.title: The Love That You Once Had
episodes.summary: Kim tries to open up to Kourtney about the overwhelming stress she's been facing. The family gathers in Palm Springs to celebrate Easter, and Khloé reflects on memories of their late father as she takes a heartfelt trip down memory lane.

episodes.title: If It Doesn’t Fit, We Must Acquit
episodes.summary: Kim, Kendall and Kylie head to New York for The Met, but Kim has her upcoming Paris robbery trial and the bar exam on her mind. Kourtney works on her sacred family bubble, while Khloé navigates parenthood with her expanding business empire.

episodes.title: The Verdict Is In
episodes.summary: Nine years after her Paris robbery, Kim returns to face the men who changed her life forever. With her childhood friend sharing her testimony and Kris by her side, Kim confronts her past in an emotional reckoning.

episodes.title: Stay The F*** Away From Me
episodes.summary: Kylie celebrates 10 years as a beauty mogul, meanwhile tensions rise between Kim, Khloé and Kourtney. When they come together to celebrate Kim's Law School graduation, 6 years in the making, the friction is palpable.

episodes.title: Dolly Freaking Parton
episodes.summary: Kylie has an unexpected visitor and needs backup from Kris and Scott, while Kim breaks down over her impending bar exam. Kourtney brings in a power player to make changes in her city, as Khloé goes to Nashville to interview her biggest idol!

episodes.title: So, Breaking News…
episodes.summary: In the season finale, Kim's long journey reaches its peak as she takes the bar exam and awaits her results. Meanwhile, months of building tension push Kourtney and Khloé's relationship to its breaking point.
